# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Rufus was a large, good-looking man of slim build, featuring a higher cheek color and paler hair than his double cousin Laurence. He possessed a distinct family ocular quirk consisting of one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Rufus possessed a small, wicked soul. He obsessively desired things until he obtained them, after which his desire vanished. Though usually pleasant and amiable when all went well, he was a heavy drinker who engaged in wild behavior.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c30 P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)_

## Traits

- Wicked  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Obsessive  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Fickle  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Heavy drinker  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c30 P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)</sub>

## Abilities

- Seamanship  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c21 P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Lorna  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## History

Rufus worked in his father Abner's store at the Glen in the winters and spent his summers sailing. He grew crazy about Lorna due to her beauty and pursued her relentlessly despite her repeatedly rejecting him. After her mother nagged Lorna into agreeing to the match to save her home, Rufus married her, establishing their residence on the Ainslie place. Quickly growing tired of domestic life, he left for Nova Scotia to visit relatives after Lorna's mother passed away. He subsequently embarked on a sea voyage to Havana aboard the ship Four Sisters alongside his cousin Laurence Vane. Upon reaching Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever. The ship was forced to depart without him, and Laurence stayed behind to tend to him until Rufus passed away from the illness thirteen years prior.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)_
